summary: Frontend-only testing of iter 79 silent-loop cinematic avatar fix. Homepage avatar and voice-lock behavior PASS. Demo-cinematic silent-loop video routing + hidden mute/fullscreen + non-installed voice lock + scene progression PASS. However: the 'Visual presence' chip-text contract is NOT implemented in ExecutiveAvatar.jsx — chips in silent-loop mode still show 'Live', 'Standing by', or 'Paused · Scene N'. Also 4 of 5 regression demos (supermarket/airport/noldus/realtor) do not expose a cinematic avatar with the expected `{demo}-demo-avatar` testid, so their regression could not be verified; only startup exposes it and shares the same chip-text bug.

ui_bugs.issue: Chip text does NOT contain 'Visual presence' as required by iter 79 spec. On /demo/school the chip reads 'Live · Scene 1 of 7' (and on /demo/startup 'Paused · Scene 1'). The `dynamicChip` useMemo (lines ~400-414) has no `silentLoopMode` branch — it only handles paused/speaking/default ('Standing by'). The in-file comment at line 261 even says 'Chip text shows Visual presence · Scene N of M', but the code never renders that string.

Could not locate cinematic avatar via `{demo}-demo-avatar` testid on these four demo pages. Either the convention differs or the cinematic ExecutiveAvatar is not wired in. Only /demo/school and /demo/startup expose `{demo}-demo-avatar`. Main agent should verify these demos also switched to silent-loop mode with the registry-driven source resolver.

critical_code_review_comments: ExecutiveAvatar.jsx line 400-414: the `dynamicChip` memo does not react to `silentLoopMode`. The spec explicitly requires 'Visual presence' copy in silent mode. Simple 3-line fix.

ExecutiveAvatar.jsx silentLoopMode also should probably suppress the `speaking` animation state on the chip-dot to match the 'visual presence only, no narration' contract. Currently chip pulse still blinks based on video.playing.

demoAvatarRegistry.js is consistent: every demo has `scenes: {}` so silent-loop mode is universal — confirms that any demo rendering the cinematic avatar should display 'Visual presence' chip (strengthens the bug report).
No duplicate export default found — the iter-79 mid-iter parsing bug stays fixed.

rca of the issue: RCA: Iter 79 introduced silentLoopMode flag (ExecutiveAvatar.jsx line 261) correctly for source selection (line 220-230), voice-lock gating (line 285-289), auto-unmute skip (line 307), mute/fullscreen UI hide (line 547, 562), and initial muted state (line 269). However the `dynamicChip` memo at line 400-414 was not updated — the intended 'Visual presence · Scene N of M' copy (documented in the line-261 comment) was never wired. Reproduction: open /demo/school → inspect `[data-testid='school-demo-avatar']` chip → shows 'Live · Scene 1 of 7' when demo TTS fires, 'Standing by · Scene 1 of 7' when idle, 'Paused · Scene 1' when paused. Mitigation: add `if (silentLoopMode) return \`Visual presence · Scene ${sceneIndex + 1}${sceneCount ? ' of ' + sceneCount : ''}\`;` as the first branch inside dynamicChip (after the `!cinematic` guard) and include `silentLoopMode` in the dependency array.
